Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: QvtpyStageSpec

   One QVTpy pipeline stage: its tool id/label/module and which CLI arguments it requires.


   .. py:attribute:: tool_id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: label
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: module
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: needs_subject
      :type:  bool
      :value: True



   .. py:attribute:: needs_nifti_root
      :type:  bool
      :value: True



   .. py:attribute:: needs_output_root
      :type:  bool
      :value: True



   .. py:attribute:: needs_dicom_root
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



   .. py:attribute:: is_download
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



.. py:data:: _QVT_COMMON_REQUIRED
   :value: ('subject', 'nifti_root', 'output_root')


.. py:data:: STAGE_SPECS
   :type:  tuple[QvtpyStageSpec, Ellipsis]

.. py:data:: STAGE_BY_ID
   :type:  dict[str, QvtpyStageSpec]

.. py:function:: _req(params: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> str

   Return the stripped string value of required parameter *key* in *params*; raises ``ValueError``
   if missing or blank.


.. py:function:: build_qvtpy_stage_argv(tool_id: str, params: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]

   Return argv for ``python -m <stage_module>``.


.. py:function:: default_dicom_root() -> str

   Default DICOM root directory from the QVTpy pipeline config, or ``""`` if unavailable.
